description: This file contains implementation of peephole optimization passes for Torch JIT, including small graph transformations and fusion passes used in PyTorch's JIT compiler.

classes.name: PeepholeOptimizeImpl
classes.description: Implements the peephole optimization pass for Torch JIT graphs, including various small graph transformations and pattern matching for optimization.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the peephole optimization pass on the graph, applying multiple small transformations.

methods.name: optimizeBlock
methods.description: Recursively optimizes a block of nodes in the graph, applying specific pattern-based transformations.

methods.name: FuseAddMM
methods.description: Fuses add and matrix multiplication nodes into a single addmm node for ONNX export.

methods.name: FuseAddMM (graph version)
methods.description: Applies the addmm fusion to the entire graph.

methods.name: PeepholeOptimize
methods.description: Main entry point for running peephole optimizations on a graph, with optional addmm fusion.
